title: Question 7.1: Testing Individual Reviews - Creating DataFrame
code_section: Testing - Creating DataFrame for Single Review (Lines 351-357)
instruction: This code creates a dataset from a single piece of text. Think about how you might convert a single value into the format the model expects.
reveal: This code creates a small dataset with just one review. `RowFactory.create(review, 0)` creates a row with the review text and a dummy label of 0. `Arrays.asList()` puts this single row into a list, and `spark.createDataFrame()` converts it into a Dataset with the specified schema. The dummy label is needed because the schema requires a label column, but we don't know the actual label yet - that's what we're trying to predict!
